LESSON 32 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Form button types

A button inside a form defaults to submit unless a type is specified. type="button" has no default
submission action; reset restores initial values.
Form ඇතුJළේ button එකෙ default Jලස submit Jවනවා. type="button" එකෙ submit කෙරන්Jන් නුහු. reset එකෙ initial values නුව+ ලබාJදෙනවා.
A signup form has a password visibility button and a submit button.
Signup form · Password · •••••••• · Show password Reset Register · type=button type=reset type=submit · Specify button type to avoid accidental submission.

Read the diagram: The Show password button requires JavaScript to perform its action; it does not
submit the form. Reset restores defaults. Register submits if validation succeeds.

<form action="/signup" method="post">
  <input name="password" type="password" required>
  <button type="button">Show password</button>
  <button type="reset">Reset</button>
  <button type="submit">Register</button>
</form>

Expected result: Show password does nothing until scripted; Reset restores values; Register
submits.
Interview question: Why specify type="button" for a UI action inside a form?
Answer: To prevent accidental form submission.
Remember: Button type determines default behavior.
Practice: Build a form with a non-submitting Cancel button.
